Subject: Post-demo alignment: economic signals, procurement path & champion brief

Hi Liam — great to meet earlier, thanks for the time and the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our side and two asks so we can keep momentum going.

Recap (30-min demo highlights)
- Key outcome: 40–60% estimated per-request cost reduction when using prefix caching + quantized variant for batch inference in your nightly ETL path.
- Performance: sub-150ms p95 for 1–2 token completions on dedicated configuration we showed.
- Security: private deployment option with customer-managed KMS, audit logs.

What I need from you (two quick asks)
1) Stakeholder map: can you confirm the economic buyer and the procurement contact who will own contracting? You mentioned Rebecca Miller (CFO) and Ana in procurement — can you confirm full names and best email?
2) Procurement timeline & must-haves: rough timing for procurement review, any standard PO/terms templates, and whether SOC 2 evidence + data residency language are gating items.

Champion enablement: attached is a one‑pager you can share with Rebecca/Ana that highlights the unit-economics and the 3-slide ROI snapshot we discussed (redwood-one-pager.pdf). If helpful I can have a tailored ROI worksheet for your team next week.

Suggested next step
- Intro meeting: 30 minutes with Ana + Rebecca (if available) to walk procurement and finance through the economics and the SLAs. Proposed window: Sep 9–10. Are either of those dates good?

I'll follow up with Sergio (cc'd) and Karthik to align materials — Sergio will produce a quick ROI model; Karthik can draft a short security checklist we can send to Ana in advance.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0198

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the concise recap and the one-pager. Couple of quick notes from our side: 

Stakeholders
- Rebecca Miller (CFO) — primary economic approver, rebecca.miller@finvest.com. She wants a clear delta vs current cloud spend and an OPEX vs CAPEX narrative.
- Raj Patel (Head of Platform) — technical decision influence, raj.patel@finvest.com (we'll pull him in for performance/security questions).
- Ana Ruiz (Procurement lead) — procurement gatekeeper, ana.ruiz@finvest.com (cc'd).

Procurement timeline + gating items
- Tentative Q4 procurement review; target PO in late Oct if commercial terms are reasonable.
- Required: standard vendor security questionnaire, SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 in progress + roadmap), data residency confirmation, and standard MSAs are usually redlines we negotiate.

Champion note
- I'm happy to act as the internal champion on the economics — Rebecca listens when I present unit-cost and savings over the 12–18 month horizon. Please send a short ROI worksheet (single-tab) that I can use in a finance-facing slide.

Next step
- Ana, can we set a 30-min intro next week? Hannah — Sep 9 or 10 in the morning ET would work for us.

Cheers,
Liam
VP, Data Science | Finvest Capital
liam.oconnor@finvest.com
